This fruit is found chiefly in hot and humid climates, especially in jungles and rainforests, and is best known in south-western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains extremely hard to find.

Curfalaka fruit is eaten to accelerate recovery from muscular injuries. Its hot jungle habitat limits gathering outside those regions. Although it is a restorative remedy, repeated use carries a risk of habituation.
